question: Which additional groups may also come into contact with the linga in worldly situations?
premises: Contact is possible beyond the uninitiated generally.
Outcastes and śvapacas may also be involved.
inference: Contact may occur even from lower classes, outcastes, and śvapacas.
uncertainties: The social terms are rendered functionally according to context.
plain_english: Likewise, even by those of lower classes, by outcastes, and by dog-cookers.
